# Spot effect fixtures

Each `<id>.dat` is the file of that id in config group 13 of index 2 of snapshot 430, as the cache stores it. `SpotAnimDefinitions.json` holds the rows of the same ids from RuneLite's decoding of snapshot 430 (the dump of the data workspace, `spotanims/SpotAnimDefinitions.json`), which supplies the expected values. The key `rotaton` is spelled as in that dump.

The ids: 86 (smoke puff, sequence 654), 188 (a wide smoke puff), 931 (a resized smoke puff with ambient and contrast), 469 (steam), 9 (recolours), 79 (rotation 270) and 314 (ambient 192, above 127).
